product_policy.windows_gui: Final Windows product is a portable outer wbd.exe. It self-elevates via UAC, extracts and SHA-verifies its embedded runtime, reads strict wbd.json beside the executable by default, exposes Npcap install/repair without redistributing Npcap Free Edition, keeps VPN running on minimize/X, and performs WBD-owned cleanup on explicit Disconnect/Exit.
